name: InstallDart
description: Download the Dart SDK, cache it in the agent tool cache, and add dart to the PATH.
helpMarkDown: Installs a Dart SDK channel (`stable`, `beta`, `dev`, `main`), release (`3.9`), or exact version (`3.9.4`), and sets `DART_HOME` and `PUB_CACHE`. [Overview](https://github.com/jeremy-morren/install-dart/blob/main/docs/Overview.md)
author: Install Dart contributors

inputs.name: sdk
inputs.label: SDK
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Which SDK version to setup. Can be specified using one of three forms:

* A release channel, which will install the latest build from that channel. Available channels are `stable`, `beta`, `dev`, and `main`. See the [Dart SDK archive](https://dart.dev/get-dart/archive) for details.
* An SDK release version - e.g. `2.19` or `3.1`. This will install the latest patch release for that specific release version.
* A specific SDK version, e.g. `2.19.0` or `2.12.0-1.4.beta`.

inputs.name: flavor
inputs.label: Build flavor
inputs.helpMarkDown:
Which build flavor to setup.

* The available build flavors are `release` and `raw`.
* The `release` flavor contains published builds.
* The `raw` flavor contains unpublished builds; these can be used by developers to test against SDK versions before a signed release is available. Note that the `main` release channel only supports the `raw` build flavor. Raw builds are not cached.
* `auto` (the default) uses `raw` for the `main` channel and `release` otherwise.

inputs.name: architecture
inputs.label: Architecture
inputs.helpMarkDown:
The CPU architecture to setup support for.

* Valid options are `x64`, `ia32`, `arm`, and `arm64`.
* `auto` (the default) uses the agent's architecture.
* Note that not all CPU architectures are supported on all operating systems; see the [Dart system requirements](https://dart.dev/get-dart#system-requirements) for valid combinations.
